country.evidence_quote: Volda University College (VUC) is among the leading higher education institutions in Norway with regards to faculty/staff exchange through the Erasmus+ programme. The International Board at VUC aims to build further on this success.

contact.name: Iulia Beleuta
contact.evidence_quote: The program is designed mainly for employees of International offices at our partner universities, but of course, we are open and welcome colleagues interested in the dynamic world of student and staff exchange, international agreements, intercultural programmes etc. ... Cecilie Wilhelmsen - Iulia Beleuta

alternates.name: Kjell Holby
alternates.evidence_quote: Kjell Holby, the international coordinator at VUC, has been accompanying the Czech guests. He is positive about the chance to expand the cooperation between VUC and the CzechRepublic.
alternates.why_chosen: Mobility coordinator. Kjell Holby is the international coordinator at VUC and manages student and teacher exchange partnerships.

contacts.rung: International relations officer. Iulia Beleuta is listed as a contact for Erasmus staff training and works within the international office context.
